GENERAL
October 17 192 2

REPORT ON Mr. McDavid's View on Dangers of Russian
Immigration.

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,

I beg to report that I have interviewed Mr.
W. J. McDavid who is prepared to accept any congenial
post the Municipal Council has to offer at a salary of
$300.00 per month. Mr. McDavid, who is a native of
Scotland, aged 38, went in 1907 to Russia where he secured
employment as a Professor in the Institute of Mining
Engineers, and later obtained a similar post in the Naval
College in Petrograd. In 1914 he joined L. Sutro & Co.
as commercial correspondent and afterwards transferred
to the Russo-American Indian Rubber Co., Treugolnik where
on attaining a post as director he had control over 2,500
clerks and 18,000 manual workers. He left Russia proper in 1918
since when he has been in Vladivostock with the exception
of about a year occupied in making a trip around the world.
Mr. McDavid speaks English, Russian and some German, and
possesses excellent testimonials from former employers.
He states that he can afford to work for $300.00 per month
as he has a private income of a similar amount.

Mr. McDavid is of opinion that Vladivostock will
fall into the hands of the "Reds" when the Japanese
evacuation is completed or soon afterwards. With the "Red"
occupation, a general exodus from the city will take place
and many refugees including undesirables, will come to
Shanghai. Mr. McDavid thinks that these people will prove
a serious menace to good order in the Settlement, and
suggests that measures should be taken to keep them out.

关于麦克戴维（McDavid）先生对俄国移民危险之看法的报告。

由副督察吉文斯（D. I. Givens）呈报，经刑事情报处处长转呈。

阁下：

谨此报告，本人已会见W. J. 麦克戴维（W. J. McDavid）先生，他愿意以月薪300.00美元的薪资接受工部局提供的任何适宜职位。麦克戴维先生系苏格兰人，现年38岁，于1907年前往俄国，在矿业工程师学院谋得教授一职，随后又在彼得格勒海军学院获得类似职位。1914年，他加入L. Sutro & Co.公司担任商业通讯员，后转入三角牌俄美印度橡胶公司（Russo-American Indian Rubber Co., Treugolnik），在升任董事后，管辖2,500名职员和18,000名体力工人。他于1918年离开俄国本土，此后一直居住在符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock），其间除约一年时间用于环球旅行外，未离该地。麦克戴维先生通晓英语、俄语及少许德语，并持有前雇主出具的极佳推荐信。他表示，由于拥有同等数额的私人收入，他可以接受月薪300.00美元的工作。

麦克戴维先生认为，一旦日军完成撤离或在此后不久，符拉迪沃斯托克将落入“赤色分子”手中。随着“赤色分子”的占领，该市将出现大规模外逃，许多难民（包括不受欢迎者）将来到上海。麦克戴维先生认为，这些人将对租界的良好秩序构成严重威胁，并建议采取措施将其拒之门外。

He thinks that this could best be done through an arrangement whereby the Chinese Consuls in Vladivostock and North Manchuria would undertake not to grant visas for Shanghai to any Russians considered undesirable, and that representatives of the Municipal Council be appointed to advise the consuls in this respect. Mr. McDavid considers that no Russian should be allowed to land here unless possessed of sufficient means to keep himself without working for a year. This rule is already enforced in Japan where every Russian before securing permission to land must show proof that he possesses Yen 1,500 and a further equivalent sum for each dependent accompanying him. Mr. McDavid is confident that enforcement of a similar rule in Shanghai would go a long way towards removing the menace to which the Settlement is exposed by Russian immigration.

In his description about conditions in Siberia, Mr. McDavid confirms reports previously heard of the extravagant ideas entertained by the people in the coastal towns of that country regarding Shanghai. Many of the men think that this is a place where everybody prospers and the women feel convinced that if they could once land here their future would be secured by accepting one of the many proposals they are sure to receive from well circumstanced young Americans and Englishmen. 他认为，最佳做法是通过一项安排，即由驻符拉迪沃斯托克及北满的中国领事承诺不向任何被视为不受欢迎的俄国人签发前往上海的签证，并由工部局指派代表就此事项向领事提供建议。麦克戴维先生认为，除非俄国人拥有足以维持一年生活而无需工作的充足资金，否则不应允许其在此登陆。日本已执行此项规定，每名俄国人在获准登陆前必须证明其拥有1,500日元，且每有一名随行受赡养人，还需出示等额的额外款项。麦克戴维先生确信，在上海执行类似规定，将在很大程度上消除俄国移民给租界带来的威胁。

在描述西伯利亚的状况时，麦克戴维先生证实了此前听到的有关该国沿海城镇居民对上海抱有不切实际想法的报告。许多男性认为这是一个每个人都能发财的地方，而女性则深信，只要一旦在此登陆，通过接受那些境遇优渥的年轻美国人和英国人肯定会向她们提出的众多求婚，她们的未来便能得到保障。有可能通过在滨海边疆区（Primorie）报纸上刊登广告，说明此类
